Overview.Name: Aditi Shet
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: Paneer cubes (100 g) pan fried in small butter + any 1 fruit
Option 2: 2 egg omelette (light butter) + any 1 fruit
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry & curd (200 g)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (100 g) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable curry
Meal_3 (Dinner - focus): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g, low oil)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & egg omelette (2 eggs) + cucumber salad
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & paneer cubes (80 g) + vegetable curry

Notes_and_Tips: Use butter in small quantities and avoid excess oil.
Maintain consistent meal timing to support thyroid health.
Start meals with protein before eating rice.
Avoid fried foods especially during stress.
Keep dinner balanced and controlled for better fat loss and energy.
